input_template: Configure a simpeg prediction case for ip_chargeability: Induced polarization (IP) survey with Cole-Cole polarization model; apparent chargeability vs. electrode spacing. The governing context is Geophysical inversion simulation (SimPEG). Elliptic PDE: ∇·(σ∇φ) = −Iδ. 1D layered earth model solved analytically (DC/IP) or via transfer-matrix method (MT/TEM). Outputs: apparent resistivity (Ω·m), impedance phase (°), transient EMF (normalized), or apparent chargeability (dimensionless) as a function of electrode spacing / frequency / time. Use the following parameterization: sigma_bg (background electrical conductivity of the host rock) is {value_0} S/m; sigma_anomaly, representing electrical conductivity of the anomaly body, is set to {value_1} S/m; depth_top = {value_2} m for top depth of the anomaly body; bottom depth of the anomaly body (depth_bottom) takes {value_3} m; width_x (horizontal width of the anomaly body) is {value_4} m. Additional controls are width_z, representing vertical thickness of the anomaly body, is set to {value_5} m; source_spacing = {value_6} m for transmitter-receiver electrode spacing (DC/IP) or loop radius (TEM); relative measurement noise level (fraction of signal) (noise_level) takes {value_7}; n_layers (number of horizontal earth layers in the model) is {value_8}; survey_length, representing total survey profile length, is set to {value_9} m. Remaining physical or categorical settings are chargeability = {value_10} for intrinsic chargeability (Cole-Cole model, IP/TEM scenarios); Cole-Cole relaxation time constant (IP) or TEM decay time constant (time_constant) takes {value_11} s; freq_min (minimum MT sounding frequency) is {value_12} Hz; freq_max, representing maximum MT sounding frequency, is set to {value_13} Hz; mu_r = {value_14} for relative magnetic permeability. Use full survey curve, 100 measurement points; observed channels: measurement channel 1 (1 of 1) and predict geophysical_response.
target_template: The simulated geophysical_response time series is{output_0}
